newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Westpac NZ lifts profit, pleased with merger.
newsitem.headline: Westpac NZ lifts profit, pleased with merger.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corporation's New Zealand division on Tuesday reported a rise in after-tax profit to NZ$127.3 million for the year to September 30 from $113.1 millon a year earlier, and said it was pleased with its merger with Trust Bank NZ Ltd.
Trust Bank contributed $31.3 million after tax, but costs associated with the acquisition and merger earlier this year totalled $43.7 million.

Westpac said it had invested around NZ$2.1 billion with the purchase of Trust Bank, mortgage portfolios from Housing Corporation and Mortgage Corporation, and its establishment of The Home Mortgage Company.
The bank's New Zealand assets rose $12 billion to $26.4 billion as at September 30.
The combined bank now has more than 1.2 million customers and is the biggest bank in New Zealand, Westpac said.
